items.headline: Man, 59, charged with murder over fatal stabbing of neighbour at Lengkok Bahru
items.summary: Ng Swee Seng, 59, charged on 22 July with murdering neighbour Thiyagarajan Karunakaran, found stabbed at a Lengkok Bahru lift lobby on 20 July.

items.headline: Malaysian man jailed 11.5 years and nine strokes for raping colleague after work dinner
items.summary: Beh Kien Tai, 37, jailed 11.5 years and nine strokes for raping a 39-year-old woman after a company dinner.

items.headline: Hair salon staffer jailed six weeks for spending customers' CDC vouchers
items.summary: Phang Koh Xing, 31, jailed six weeks for spending S$1,167 of two customers' CDC vouchers at Yun Nam Hair Care.

items.headline: Green Lamborghini Gallardo bursts into flames on the East Coast Parkway
items.summary: A green Lamborghini Gallardo caught fire on the ECP on 23 July; SCDF put it out, no injuries.

items.headline: Man, 23, charged over taser possession after pre-dawn Boat Quay brawl
items.summary: A 23-year-old charged on 21 July with taser possession over a 19 July Boat Quay fight.

items.headline: DRDO conducts maiden flight test of indigenous Kusha long-range air-defence missile
items.summary: DRDO tested the Kusha long-range SAM off Odisha on 23 July; Rajnath Singh said it cuts import dependence.

items.headline: Sonam Wangchuk ends 26-day hunger strike after Union ministers intervene
items.summary: Ladakh activist Sonam Wangchuk ended his 26-day fast on 23 July after Union ministers intervened.

items.headline: Kerala suspends ADGP Ajith Kumar over cover-up in Youth Congress assault probe
items.summary: Kerala suspended ADGP M R Ajith Kumar on 23 July for shielding police who assaulted Youth Congress workers.

items.headline: Homes razed and 2,500 detained across Kashmir after Anantnag policeman's killing
items.summary: Forces razed two suspected militants' homes and detained ~2,500 after the Anantnag attack; Omar Abdullah criticised the crackdown.

items.headline: Centre splits urban affairs ministry to create a Delhi-focused capital development department
items.summary: Govt split the Housing and Urban Affairs ministry into a Delhi-NCR capital department and a national urban department on 23 July.

items.headline: Burnham cuts business rates 20% for England's pubs, clubs and music venues
items.summary: PM Andy Burnham cut business rates 20% for ~32,000 pubs, clubs and venues from April 2026, ~£100m cost.

items.headline: Burnham tells Scotland a fresh independence referendum is off limits
items.summary: Meeting John Swinney in Glasgow on 23 July, Burnham ruled out a second independence vote.

items.headline: More than 100 UK millionaires urge PM Burnham to raise their taxes
items.summary: Over 100 wealthy Britons publicly asked PM Burnham to raise taxes on the richest.

items.headline: Markets steady as John Healey replaces sacked Rachel Reeves as Chancellor
items.summary: Burnham named John Healey Chancellor after sacking Rachel Reeves; gilt yields eased on 21 July.

items.headline: Hedge funds ramp up bets against UK stocks as Burnham pledges 'new economic model'
items.summary: UK short positions rose fivefold in H1 2026 as funds bet against Burnham's reindustrialisation plan.

items.headline: Rubio and Lavrov meet in Manila in first US-Russia talks since September
items.summary: Rubio and Lavrov held ~35 minutes of talks at the ASEAN forum in Manila on 23 July; Lavrov cited readiness for a settlement.

items.headline: Trump says signed Saudi nuclear deal now hinges on normalising ties with Israel
items.summary: Trump said the 22 July US-Saudi nuclear pact is 'totally subject' to Riyadh joining the Abraham Accords.

items.headline: Wildfires force more than 20,000 to flee southwest France as Spain and Italy burn
items.summary: ~20,000 evacuated near Bordeaux on 23 July; three firefighters dead this week, Spain's Guadalajara blaze ~32,000 ha.

items.headline: US judge sets June 2027 trial date for Venezuela's Maduro and his wife
items.summary: Judge Hellerstein set 1 June 2027 for the trial of Maduro and Cilia Flores; both pleaded not guilty on 22 July.

items.headline: Monsoon floods kill at least 82 across India, Pakistan and Afghanistan
items.summary: At least 82 died this week in floods across India, Pakistan and Afghanistan; Nuristan alone 20+ dead, 100+ missing.

items.headline: AI chip startup Etched doubles to $10.3 billion valuation in Sequoia-led round
items.summary: Etched closed a $300m Series C at a $10.3bn valuation on 23 July, doubling its December mark; ~$1bn in orders.

items.headline: AMD to invest up to $5 billion in Anthropic in a new AI-chip supply deal
items.summary: AMD to invest up to $5bn in Anthropic and supply Instinct MI450 GPUs; Anthropic to buy up to 2GW from H1 2027.

items.headline: EU hits Google with first Digital Markets Act fines, totalling €890 million
items.summary: The EU fined Google €890m on 23 July under the DMA (€460m Search, €430m Play Store); 60 days to pay.

items.headline: US Treasury threatens sanctions over China's Kimi K3 AI model
items.summary: Treasury's Bessent said sanctions remain possible after the White House accused Moonshot of distilling Anthropic's Fable for Kimi K3.

items.headline: AMD launches 256-core EPYC 'Venice' server chip on TSMC's 2nm process
items.summary: At Advancing AI 2026, AMD unveiled the Zen 6 EPYC 'Venice' with up to 256 cores on TSMC 2nm.

items.headline: Wall Street sells off as Alphabet and Tesla slump and oil tops $100
items.summary: S&P 500 fell 1.21% to 7,408.30, Nasdaq -2.15% to 25,137.69 on 23 July as Alphabet (-7%) and Tesla (-14%) slid.

items.headline: Intel revenue jumps 25% to $16.1 billion on AI demand; shares leap
items.summary: Intel Q2 revenue rose 25% to $16.1bn with adj EPS $0.42, stock +11%; data-centre and AI revenue up 59%.

items.headline: ECB holds rates at 2.25% as Lagarde leaves the door open to a September hike
items.summary: The ECB held its deposit rate at 2.25% on 23 July; Lagarde signalled a possible September increase.

items.headline: US jobless claims fall to 187,000, the fewest since 1969
items.summary: Initial US claims fell 22,000 to 187,000 for the week ended 18 July, the lowest since September 1969.

items.headline: Update: Brent crude tops $100 after Houthi strike on two Saudi tankers
items.summary: Brent jumped 7% to $100.66 on 23 July after Houthis struck two Saudi tankers; WTI +6.3% to $92.28.

items.headline: 🏎️ Corner-heavy Hungaroring could revive Hamilton and Ferrari's title fight with Antonelli
items.summary: Antonelli leads Hamilton by 45 points at the Hungarian GP, but the Hungaroring is tipped to suit Ferrari.

items.headline: 🏎️ Red Bull says top drivers are calling but backs Verstappen to stay for 2027
items.summary: Laurent Mekies said Red Bull is fielding calls from 'good drivers' as Verstappen's exit clause looms but expects him to stay.

items.headline: 🏏 India beat Zimbabwe by seven wickets in the first T20I in Harare
items.summary: India led 1-0, restricting Zimbabwe to 125/7 and chasing 126/3 in 13.2 overs; Mayank Yadav 2/18, player of the match.

items.headline: 🏏 Manchester Super Giants crush London Spirit at Lord's in The Hundred opener
items.summary: Manchester Super Giants beat London Spirit by seven wickets; Ryana MacDonald-Gay 4/17 bowled Spirit out for 80.

items.headline: 🎾 Defending champion Bublik reaches the Kitzbuhel semi-finals
items.summary: Top seed Alexander Bublik beat Alex Molcan 6-3, 6-2 to reach the Generali Open semi-finals on 23 July.

items.headline: Webb uncovers a hidden third giant planet in the Beta Pictoris system
items.summary: Astronomers detected Beta Pictoris d (2-4 Jupiter masses, 63 ly) via its atmosphere; the system's third directly detected planet.

items.headline: Decades-old near-Earth 'asteroid' turns out to be a faint dark comet
items.summary: JPL's Farnocchia predicted 1998 SH2 was outgassing and confirmed a faint tail; reclassified as comet P/1998 SH2.

items.headline: Scientists grow early human sperm cells from stem cells inside a mouse 'mini-testis'
items.summary: A Penn-led team grew human spermatogonia for 6+ months inside mouse-hosted testis structures, short of mature sperm.

items.headline: Astronomers find the first atmosphere on a rocky planet in a habitable zone
items.summary: Researchers found helium escaping LHS 1140 b, a super-Earth 48 ly away, the first atmosphere on a rocky habitable-zone world.

items.headline: First Classic Maya astronomer identified by name from a 1,200-year-old wall
items.summary: Researchers deciphered the name Sak Tahn Waax beside a 781 CE astronomical formula at Xultun, Guatemala.

fun_fact.headline: A shuffled 52-card deck is almost certainly a never-before-seen order
fun_fact.body: Shuffle a standard 52-card deck thoroughly and you have almost certainly produced an ordering that has never existed before. The number of possible arrangements is 52 factorial (about 8 x 10^67), which utterly dwarfs the roughly 4 x 10^17 seconds that have elapsed since the Big Bang.
fun_fact.source: McGill Office for Science and Society

puzzle.title: The Three Logicians
puzzle.body: Three perfect logicians are asked if everyone wants a drink; the first two say 'I don't know' and the third says 'Yes'.
puzzle.approach: Treat each 'I don't know' as information about the speaker's own wish.
puzzle.answer: Yes, all three want a drink. Each 'I don't know' reveals that speaker wants one but is unsure of the others; the third, having heard both, knows all three do.

word_puzzle.title: Sides of the Story
word_puzzle.body: Letter Boxed square, sides Top D G R, Right A H N, Bottom U T O, Left E S I; use all 12 letters.
word_puzzle.approach: Chain two words using all 12 letters; consecutive letters from different sides.
word_puzzle.answer: DAUGHTERS then SNORING covers all 12 letters.

UK News ran on fallback sources (Al Jazeera, CNBC, Bloomberg): BBC, Sky News and The Guardian were all unreachable. Items remain UK-domestic.

Global, Tech and Business articles could not be fetch-verified (news domains 403 via the proxy); each URL and fact was corroborated across live search results.
